rationale: EUDI PID Rulebook v1.6 s3.1.2. Element identifiers are the rulebook's SECOND column - the one used on the wire - which is not always the attribute's name: the attribute birth_place is carried as the element place_of_birth. NOTE what is deliberately NOT here: age_over_18. The mDL carries it (ISO/IEC 18013-5 s13.4.6) and it is the obvious thing to reach for, but the PID rulebook removed the age attributes in v1.1 following CIR 2024/2977. Adding them back because another credential has them would put a non-rulebook element in a rulebook doctype - exactly what an interop test exists to catch. Proof of age lives in age-over-18-mdoc instead.

claims.name: place_of_birth
claims.note: PID Rulebook §2 mandatory birth_place, §3.1.4/§4.1.1 place_of_birth: { ? country, ? region, ? locality }. Optional here - carried when the holder's passport or profile has it (captured at onboarding since 2026-09-30, G-18); David's call is that a PID needs no scanned document, so it is not refused without one.
